title: Italian Wood Ear Mushrooms Panforte
description: A funky and fluffy Italian dish featuring wood ear mushrooms, pasta water emulsion, and halal friendly ingredients, served in a panforte form in a ramekin, perfect as a hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Reconstitute the dried wood ear mushrooms by soaking them in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain and chop them into small pieces.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pasta water, salt, black pepper, and beaten eggs.
Add the grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the cooked mushroom mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins and bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the panforte from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
